row.body: The packed bag contains field gloves and a route card crossed out at the supply stop. A separate line records that the crew heard shots and left the load.
row.title: Too heavy to carry

cites.quote: got halfway but had to leave it all - too heavy

sidecar.gloss: A field load was left behind after a route was interrupted.
sidecar.rival_reading: A response convoy could have abandoned supplies after gunfire; the card does not identify the crew or its work.
